names.pullman_house_1729_prairie_ranges: 1729 Prairie Avenue — the Pullman estate's stable and one-storey ranges

source.citation: J. W. Taylor (Chicago), photographer. Pullman, George M., Residence [from the south-west, showing the palm house and stable]. Photograph, c. 1890-1910 (holder's view date). Art Institute of Chicago, Ryerson and Burnham Archives, Architecture Photograph Collection (Historic Architecture and Landscape Image Collection), no. 16554.
what_it_does_not_supply: the arcade, which the bay and the planting hide from this side
what_it_supplies: the stable's window count east of the bay (three bays, two storeys) and the stack at its east end
the lantern's form (octagonal drum with lights, a dome and a finial) and its place toward the deck's west end
